# OrthoAutomate

> OrthoAutomate is a done-for-you AI automation company that installs revenue-recovery systems for private dental and orthodontic clinics — capturing missed calls, responding to ad leads in seconds, and following up on unaccepted treatment plans to recover $30,000–$150,000 per year.

## About

OrthoAutomate was founded in 2024 by a team of dental-marketing operators and AI engineers who saw private dental practices losing six figures per year to three preventable problems: missed phone calls, slow response to paid-ad leads, and unaccepted treatment plans sitting in their practice management software. Most clinics were trying to fix these leaks by hiring more front-desk staff — a slow, expensive, and unreliable solution.

OrthoAutomate replaces that approach with a fully managed AI stack that goes live in 72 hours. We handle 100% of the technical setup, integrate directly with the clinic's existing PMS (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Curve), and train the AI on the clinic's own tone, services, and pricing. Our clients typically see 300–1000% ROI in the first 90 days.

What makes OrthoAutomate different: we are dental-only. Our AI is pre-trained on dental terminology, treatment workflows, and common patient objections. We do not serve any other vertical, which is why our systems convert better than generic AI receptionist tools.

## Services

- 24/7 AI Receptionist — Answers every dental clinic call in under 2 seconds, books appointments directly into the calendar, handles FAQs, and routes urgent or human-required cases to the front desk.
- Instant AI Lead Response — Replies to every Google, Facebook, and Instagram ad lead in under 60 seconds via SMS and DM, qualifying and booking them automatically with up to 8x higher booking rates.
- AI Treatment Plan Follow-Up — Nurtures unaccepted treatment plans with personalized 30–60 day SMS and email sequences, prioritizing high-value $3K+ cases and recovering 15–25% of stuck plans on average.
- Free Revenue Leak Audit — A no-obligation analysis of a clinic's missed-call volume, lead response time, and unaccepted treatment-plan value, with a clear dollar figure of recoverable revenue.

## Who we serve

OrthoAutomate works with private dental practices, orthodontic clinics, cosmetic dentists, implant centers, periodontists, pediatric dentists, and small DSO groups doing $800,000–$3,000,000 per year in production. Our typical client is an owner-operated practice losing revenue to missed calls, slow ad lead response, or stuck treatment plans, and wants results without hiring more front-desk staff. We do not serve hospitals, insurance companies, or non-dental verticals.
